Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around the DieHarder specification of the classic Die Hard water-jug problem. Its purpose is not to define the full transition system itself, but to provide concrete values for constants that the underlying DieHarder module expects, because TLC configuration files cannot directly supply certain function-valued expressions. In particular, it defines a concrete jug set and a capacity function over that set, duplicating the original two-jug problem with jugs j1 and j2 having capacities 3 and 5 respectively.
